dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent, and I'll be looking into these symptoms for you today. When did you first notice the blisters on your forearm and the ulcers on your mucosal surfaces?

The blisters on my forearm showed up about three days ago, but the sores in my mouth and down below have been bothering me for a week. It’s reached the point where it’s really painful to eat or even have intimacy with my husband. I thought it might be something from the woods, but I don't think I touched any poisonous plants.
I'm sorry to hear how much discomfort this is causing you. If you rub the skin near one of the blisters, does the top layer peel or slide off easily?

Actually, I noticed that earlier today when I was cleaning my arm; the skin just sort of slid right off when I pressed on it. It’s very strange because the blisters themselves seem quite thin and break easily. Does that help you figure out what's going on?

That detail is very helpful for my assessment. Have you experienced any fever, or have you recently started any new medications? 

REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy_with_DIF
RESULTS: Histopathology shows acantholysis and intraepidermal blister formation. Direct Immunofluorescence (DIF) shows intercellular IgG and C3 deposition within the epidermis.
